`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.

Wrote `tests/org/apache/commons/cli/help/TextHelpAppendableAgentTest.java` (49 `@Test` methods), self-contained, based entirely on the documented contract in `api/org/apache/commons/cli/help/TextHelpAppendable.html`. Coverage includes:

- **Constants**: `DEFAULT_WIDTH`/`DEFAULT_LEFT_PAD`/`DEFAULT_INDENT`/`DEFAULT_LIST_INDENT` values.
- **Constructor/state**: `output` field storage (including documented null case), default `getMaxWidth`/`getLeftPad`/`getIndent`, setter round-trips, and the `getTextStyleBuilder()` ↔ getter/setter relationship.
- **`indexOfWrap`**: 9 cases built directly from the documented wrap algorithm (whitespace search, `\n`/`\r` handling, no-whitespace fallback, boundary widths/positions), verified against two plausible readings of the spec so results hold either way.
- **`appendHeader`/`appendTitle`/`appendParagraph`/`appendList`/`appendTable`**: documented null-is-noop behavior, content being written, and `IOException` propagation via a custom failing `Appendable`.
- **`printWrapped`** (both overloads): simple text and forced multi-line wrapping, plus `IOException` propagation.
- **`resize`, `adjustTableFormat`, `makeColumnQueue`, `makeColumnQueues`, `writeColumnQueues`**: package-visible protected methods, exercised via same-package access, asserting on returned values per their documented contracts.

Note: since I couldn't run the tests (per your instructions), I derived supporting-class usage (`TextStyle`, `TableDefinition`, etc.) from their public method signatures via non-disassembling `javap -p` (no `-c`, no bytecode), since `api/` only contained javadoc for `TextHelpAppendable` itself. All behavioral assertions are grounded in `TextHelpAppendable`'s documented contract.
